_meta.note: Static verified figures rendered on /iso20022-mcp/. Every number was measured or fetched live on the dates below; nothing is projected or estimated. Refresh by re-running the measurements and updating this file.

timed_proof.method: stdio JSON-RPC client timestamps from process spawn: uvx --from "iso20022-mcp[all]" iso20022-mcp, initialize handshake, then one generate call returning a schema-valid pain.001.001.03 (gateway 0.0.4). Cold run used --cache-dir pointing at an empty directory, so the 17.5s includes resolving and downloading every package; the warm run reused the populated cache.

adoption.source: https://pypistats.org/api/packages/<package>/recent (last_month), fetched 16-17 July 2026; three packages re-fetched 17 July returned identical counts, so the figures are one consistent snapshot
